newsitem.title: USA: ABC co-anchor testifies in Food Lion trial. [CORRECTED 09:10 GMT 11/1]
newsitem.headline: ABC co-anchor testifies in Food Lion trial. [CORRECTED 09:10 GMT 11/1]

text.p: Star co-achor Diane Sawyer of Walt Disney Co's ABC PrimeTime Live program took the stand on Friday in Food Lion Inc's lawsuit over the network's hidden-camera investigation of its stores.
Sawyer testified only briefly in U.S. District Court, where jurors are hearing evidence in the punitive-damages phase of the trial.

ABC lost a civil suit late last year in which Food Lion charged it with fraud, trespass and breach of loyalty when two ABC producers used hidden cameras in a 1992 television report about the company's sanitation and food-handling practices. (Corrects to make clear that ABC lost a civil suit).

The jury awarded Food Lion, a large supermarket chain, $1,400 in compensatory damages. Food Lion, a unit of Belgian retailer ETS Delhaize Freres et Cie "LE LION' SA, reportedly is seeking up to $2 billion in punitive damages.

Dressed in a navy suit, Sawyer recounted her career in television and as an assistant to the late U.S. President Richard Nixon before the court broke for lunch. She is to resume testifying later on Friday.
